use_case_name: Resolve Dual Designations via Track Correlation

claims.content: At the main-flow correlation-eligibility step, two tracks shall not be manually correlated if they are of a different E/C, one is simulated and the other is live, or both are remote; in the simulated/live case, correlation is rejected.

At the main-flow dual-designation evaluation step, track decorrelation should occur when it is determined more than one data point exists for a ballistic missile track currently being reported. Situations most likely to lead to such dual designations include initial reports on ballistic missile contacts, track merging, simultaneous multiple launches, existence of registration errors, time of observation differences, and high velocity contacts.

At the main-flow correlation-outcome step, if a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the receiving JU accepts the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregards the J3 surveillance data on the specified track; however, if Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message is discarded.

At the main-flow correlation-outcome step, if a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the C2 JU transmits J7.2 (RV=1) with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN; if the originating C2 JU holds R2 for the Dropped TN, it drops the Dropped TN and transmits J7.0 (ACT=0) after the J7.2 message.

At the main-flow correlation-restriction step, if either subject track is the Target TN in a J10.2 Engagement Status message originated by the unit attempting correlation, has an ID of Unknown or Hostile, and the other subject track has an ID of Friend, automatic correlation may be allowed, and the Unknown/Hostile track is the dropped TN (TN-2).

At the main-flow J7.2 acceptance step, the engagement-status exception shall not be applied; a JU receiving a J7.2 Correlation message while holding OCCs on both tracks or conflicting IDs on the two tracks (if the ID conflict correlation restriction is enabled) shall reject the correlation.

At the main-flow track-state step, if a ballistic missile track is considered lost — because the JU with R2 has not received any local sensor data since the last transmitted update, or the JU determines that the track is lost by other system criteria — subsequent reports include held data and set the Lost Track Indicator to value 1; a JU reporting a lost track is assumed to have a TQ of 5 less than that being reported, so a JU holding tracking data may assume R2 with a TQ of 11 for a reported TQ of 15.

At the main-flow correlation-acceptance step, the receiving IU accepts the requested correlation unless prespecified conditions exist that require or allow the receiving IU to reject it; an RV value of 1 indicates a reverse correlation request would be rejected.

missing_aspects: Exact main-flow step numbers for these exception divergence points are not available in the provided evidence; claims identify the divergence by correlation-processing function.
The claim states 'track decorrelation is performed' as a definitive action, whereas the evidence (EC-EF-033) uses the conditional 'should occur'. The rewrite aligns with the source text.

claims.content: C2 JU
PPLI data from J2 messages is available to the C2 JU and has been accepted into its surveillance database.
Two candidate tracks reported to the interface are available and eligible for correlation, with locally derived sensor data and interface-reported data simultaneously available for comparison.
The C2 JU has automatic correlation capability for real-time air or surface tracks.
The dual designation is resolved via correlation, and the reported ballistic missile track represents a single data point.
Upon acceptance of the requested correlation, the receiving IUs retain the designated Retained TN and drop the designated Dropped TN (subject to specific constraints).
If the originating C2 JU holds R2 for the Dropped TN, the Dropped TN is dropped and a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is transmitted after the J7.2 message.
Upon successful correlation execution, if the own unit holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the Retained TN is designated as a common local track.

Specific data fields from the Dropped TN are transferred to the Retained TN when the Dropped TN was a local or common local track: Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, Altitude, Altitude Source, TQ, and Strength.
After acceptance of a manual correlation (RV field set to value 3), the resulting track is not subject to automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.

The C2 JU continuously compares locally derived sensor data for ballistic missile tracks (e.g., position, velocity, and boost indication) with ballistic missile track data received on the Surveillance NPG interface.

The C2 JU makes an automatic correlation test either upon receipt of each remote real-time J3.2 or J3.3 track (or J2.0/J2.2/J2.3 PPLI report) not confirmed to have an existing correlation, or immediately prior to each transmission of a local track; alternatively, when the C2 JU recognizes that two tracks reported to the interface are eligible for correlation and initiates action manually, it transmits a J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C2 IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks, with the RV field set to value 3, and after acceptance the resulting track shall not be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.
When two tracks pass the correlation tests and restrictions once, the pair is deemed a tentative correlation.

The same two tracks are tested again upon the next correlation stimulus; after they pass the second correlation test and there is no correlation restriction, the C2 JU processes them for dual designation resolution.

The recognizing C2 JU (the originating JU) transmits a J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C2 IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks, identifying the Track Number to be retained (Retained TN) and the Track Number to be dropped (Dropped TN).

The receiving IUs accept the requested correlation unless prespecified conditions exist that require or allow the receiving IU to reject the requested correlation or respond with a reverse correlation request.

The originating C2 JU, holding R2 for the Dropped TN, upon successful correlation execution transfers the specific data fields from the Dropped TN to the Retained TN (Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, Altitude, Altitude Source, TQ, and Strength) and, if it holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, designates the Dropped TN as a common local track; it then drops the Dropped TN, ceases reporting it, and transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN after the J7.2 message.
When a C2 JU recognizes that two tracks being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, it initiates action—either automatically or manually—to resolve the dual designation.

The C2 JU resolves dual designations by correlating two tracks reported to the interface that are eligible for correlation, so that each ballistic missile track reported on the interface represents a single data point.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU resolves dual designations by correlating two tracks reported to the interface that are eligible for correlation, so that each ballistic missile track reported on the interface represents a single data point.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The C2 JU recognizes two interface-reported tracks as eligible for correlation, correlates them, and thereby resolves the dual designation so that the reported ballistic missile track represents a single data point.
scope_contract.start_boundary: Two tracks reported to the interface are in a dual-designation state and have been recognized as eligible for correlation.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The dual designation is resolved via correlation; the reported ballistic missile track represents a single data point.
in_scope_actions: Correlating the two eligible interface-reported tracks
Resolving the dual designation through that correlation
excluded_adjacent_actions: General protocol objective of minimizing occurrences and duration of dual designations
Post-resolution downstream administrative actions beyond the correlation resolution

claims.content: Diverges from Step 2: Instead of relying solely on the automatic correlation test, the C2 JU may use the manual correlation capability to initiate correlation of any two tracks irrespective of the correlation test criteria, the correlation restrictions, or the correlation requirements.

Diverges from Step 4: If conflicting IDs is the only correlation restriction, the operator is alerted and may either change the local ID or the Exercise Indicator and ID (thereby allowing automatic correlation) or transmit an ID Difference Report (thereby allowing automatic correlation if the remote ID or Exercise Indicator and ID is changed).

Diverges from Step 6: Instead of accepting the requested correlation, a C2 JU responding with a reverse correlation transmits the J7.2 message with the originally received Retained TN and Dropped TN reversed and the RV field set to value 1.

Diverges from Step 7: For a manually initiated correlation (RV=3), if the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held and the Dropped TN has an OCC, the system executes the correlation using the Dropped TN data and the Retained TN track number.
Diverges from Step 7: When the C2 JU has initiated the J7.2 message and a Drop Track message has not yet been received for the Dropped TN, the Dropped TN is retained as a remote track.
Diverges from Step 7: When the Identity of the Retained TN and the Dropped TN are the same, the associated identification data reported for the Retained TN is retained.

Diverges from Step 7: When the Identity or Identity Amplifying Descriptor of the Retained TN and Dropped TN are different, and that difference would result in automatic acceptance of the Dropped TN ID/IAD, the Dropped TN ID/IAD, Special Interest Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type are transferred to the Retained TN.

quality_flags.detail: [mainflow_postconditions_reachability] Main Flow step 7 says that when the originating C2 JU holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, it designates the Dropped TN as a common local track and then drops it. Postcondition 4 instead requires the Retained TN to be designated as a common local track in that same situation. Because the Dropped TN is subsequently dropped, designating it as a common local track cannot lead to the postcondition as written; the two slots contradict each other. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The qualifier 'successful' before correlation execution is not supported; evidence states 'upon correlation execution'.; The transfer of 'Strength' is supported only when the Dropped TN was a local or common local track; the original claim omitted that condition.))

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] Main Flow step 7 states that when the Dropped TN is local/common local, the originating C2 JU designates the Dropped TN as a common local track. Postcondition 4 requires the Retained TN to be designated as the common local track. Since the Dropped TN is dropped and no longer reported, this main-flow wording cannot lead to the postcondition.

[mainflow_trigger_continuity] Trigger permits both automatic and manual initiation. Main Flow step 2 already transmits the manual J7.2 correlation request, but steps 3-4 then run the automatic two-pass correlation tests and step 5 transmits a second J7.2. The manual branch is not continued; the flow restarts into the automatic scenario after the manual J7.2 has been sent.

[mainflow_trigger_continuity] Main Flow step 1 describes the continuous comparison of local sensor data with interface data, which precedes recognition of eligibility. The trigger is recognition and initiation of resolution, so step 1 restarts before the triggered scenario rather than continuing from it.

inconsistency_hints: Main Flow step 7 drops the Dropped TN and transmits J7.0, but it does not transfer the specified data fields from the Dropped TN to the Retained TN or designate the Retained TN as a common local track. Therefore the Postconditions requiring data-field transfer and common-local designation when the Dropped TN was local/common local are not reachable from the described flow.

The Trigger allows the C2 JU to initiate resolution either automatically or manually, but Main Flow step 2 only describes an automatic correlation test and no later step handles manual correlation with RV=3. As a result, the Postcondition stating that after acceptance of a manual correlation the resulting track is protected from automatic decorrelation for 5 minutes is not reachable.

Precondition 2 duplicates the Trigger: it states that the C2 JU already recognizes the two tracks as eligible, while the Trigger is exactly that recognition event initiating action. The required pre-existing external state is that two candidate tracks reported to the interface are actually available and eligible for correlation, with both locally derived and interface-reported data simultaneously available; this is not explicitly established as a precondition.
